newsitem.title: USA: Prudential to sell residential mortage portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Prudential to sell residential mortage portfolio.

text.p: Prudential Home Mortgage Co Inc, a unit of Prudential Insurance Co of America, said on Friday that it reached an agreement to sell the rights, duties and obligations to service a $30 billion residential mortgage loan portfolio to Citicorp Mortgage Inc.
Prudential believes that the Citicorp unit will sell portions of the servicing rights to Bank United and Glendale Federal Bank, it said.

Norwest Corp, which had bought Prudential Home Mortgage's origination, servicing and secondary marketing operations, will continue to subservice the portfolio for an unspecified period, Prudential said.
This deal brings near a close Prudential's process of exiting the home mortgage business, it said.
